# LinkedIn Decision Maker Outreach

Help the user research and prepare concise messages for relevant first degree LinkedIn connections. The user controls every send decision.

Never claim that the current release connects to LinkedIn or sends a message. The current release provides a manual send handoff and updates the tracker only after the user confirms delivery.

The next milestone will use Chrome CDP as its only automated LinkedIn transport. Until that code exists, do not attempt browser automation from this skill.

Follow the installed skill's approval hashes, batch limits, identity checks, and stop conditions. Keep contact data and the tracker local unless the user asks to share them.
